reader.requirement: At --std 85, a REWRITE of an indexed file with RECORD IS VARYING whose record size (the DEPENDING ON value, or the ODO-determined size, VII.3.8.4 GR10) is below the minimum or above the maximum must be unsuccessful with I-O status 44 (IX.1.3.4 item 5d 1), leave the stored record unchanged and the record area unaffected; sizes at the bounds succeed.
reader.edition-search: grep 'Edition|DialectBehavior|CobolVersion' over IndexedConnector.cs (only the two READ behaviours, not on Rewrite), KeyedConnector.cs and FileConnector.cs (only SharingFacilityInEffect), and over KeyedIoEmitter.cs/SequentialIoEmitter.cs (only SelectWhenOnlyForFilePhraseStatements): the size check on the REWRITE path reads no edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the three witnesses are RELATIVE (l1c26_rewrite_relative_invalid_key) and RECORD SEQUENTIAL (pb1168, pb1190) files; the indexed REWRITE, which this rule's module governs, is not witnessed at 85.

reader.notes: IndexedConnector.Rewrite asks RecordRulesFailure (Stored against the FD's varying bounds) after the 49/43 open-mode and read-sequence checks and before any key rule, returning 44 without touching the store; the emitter passes the DEPENDING ON value or the ODO length as lenArg and stores nothing back into the record area. Every probed size matched the 1985 text.
